LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Vase.label: porcelain vase
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Vase.description: A tall white vase painted in cobalt blue with dragons among clouds. Merchants travel half the world to buy one.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_MoonGate.label: moon gate
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_MoonGate.description: A perfectly round opening in a garden wall. Stepping through it is said to bring luck.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lantern.label: paper lantern
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_Lantern.description: A red paper lantern on a lacquered post, with a small oil lamp inside.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaTable.label: gongfu tea table
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_TeaTable.description: A carved wooden tray table with a clay teapot and tiny cups. Tea is brewed again and again, a little stronger each time.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery_Gun.label: fire-arrow rack
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery_Gun.descript: A hexagonal box of rocket arrows mounted on a turning cart.
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery.label: fire-arrow battery
LanguageData.HE_Tianxia_FireArrowBattery.description: A wheeled 'nest of bees' that looses eight fire arrows in one volley at anything hostile in range. It needs no power, only wood to make new arrows: one log becomes two arrows. The arrows are not accurate, but they set the enemy alight.
